title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
synopsis: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

trailers.title: Walkers Are Falling From The Sky

episodes.title: Old Acquaintances
episodes.synopsis: Maggie finds Negan, and they travel to Manhattan; a marshal named Armstrong follows Negan; we meet a quiet young girl named Ginny.

episodes.title: Who's There?
episodes.synopsis: Maggie and Negan encounter native New Yorkers; Armstrong revisits a trauma; Ginny attempts to adapt to change.

episodes.title: People Are a Resource
episodes.synopsis: Dark instincts reveal themselves as Maggie and Negan form a strategy; Armstrong is tested; Ginny embarks on a daring journey.

episodes.title: Everybody Wins a Prize
episodes.synopsis: Maggie and Negan carry out an attack, but not everything unfolds according to plan; Ginny and Armstrong each make unexpected contact with others.

episodes.title: Stories We Tell Ourselves
episodes.synopsis: Truths are unearthed and motives are revealed as Maggie, Negan and the others travel further into the city's depths.

episodes.title: Doma Smo
episodes.synopsis: Tensions between Maggie and Negan come to a head; Ginny's search continues; questions arise around Armstrong's path forward.

episodes.title: Power Equals Power
episodes.synopsis: In the war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides.

episodes.title: Another Shitty Lesson
episodes.synopsis: Maggie begins a treacherous journey back to the island. Negan reluctantly joins the fight.

episodes.title: Why Did the Mainlanders Cross the River?
episodes.synopsis: Negan tries something new with The Croat. Maggie travels into a dangerous, surprising place.

episodes.title: Feisty Friendly
episodes.synopsis: Maggie uncovers surprising information. Negan attempts to outmaneuver a slippery foe.

episodes.title: The Bird Always Knows
episodes.synopsis: Negan makes some big moves, while Maggie takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Bridge Partners Are Hard to Come By These Days

episodes.synopsis: Maggie and Negan are caught in a treacherous situation that challenges their newfound alliance.
